text:
Samir Patel: Equinox sent RFI follow-ups. They want a tight POC runbook, clarifications on SLA failover, and an explicit capability matrix comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private for compliance controls. Need a publishable one-pager + cost table by EOD.

Priya Rao: I'll compile the capability matrix. Suggest rows: SOC2, ISO27001, Privacy shield/GDPR notes, KMS integrations, HSM support, data residency, encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, audit logs retention, role-based access, contract SLA.

Diego Martinez: SLA note: Dedicated contractual SLA 99.95% for the committed tier. For Hosted we offer best-effort latency SLOs in free tiers; enterprise SLAs available on request. Failover RTO: regional fallback ~5 minutes (if warm standby available) else cross-region warmup 20-40 minutes depending on model size and KV cache.

Lena Wu: POC runbook quick bullets:
- Day 0: provisioning (dedicated pool + region pin)
- Week 1: baseline benchmark, token consumption validation
- Week 2-4: test traffic patterns + load ramps
- Ops: monitor latency/error budgets -> trigger canary fallback to quantized variant
- Post-POC: handoff ops runbook & optional integration review.

Samir Patel: Priya, make the matrix explicit about which attestations apply to which deployment. Diego/Lena, include exact rehydrate numbers and a note about >30B model behavior.

Priya Rao: Draft matrix line example:
SOC2 Type II: Hosted: certified (attachment); Dedicated: covered under contract + customer tenant logs; Private: customer scope (we provide controls & guidance).

Diego Martinez: Also add a note about pre-warm option: cost adds 15-30% to POC depending on model memory footprint.

ops-bot: File uploaded: equinox_poc_cost_v3.xlsx

Samir Patel: Good. Two asks: (1) make the capability matrix one-pager PDF; (2) include cost spreadsheet with monthly breakout and one-time integration/security assessment line items.

Priya Rao: On it; I'll finalize and upload PDF. Expect v1 in 90 minutes.

Lena Wu: Ops note: If they require an on-prem HSM appliance, we require a scheduled maintenance window for connector setup and a customer-signed runbook. Add to integration scope.

Samir Patel: Add that to the POC assumptions. Thanks. Closing for now.
